lead.title: Meta ships Muse Spark Open, its most capable open-weights model yet
lead.summary: Meta open-sourced Muse Spark Open, pitched as the strongest US open-weights model to date, built for long-running agentic coding that keeps entire codebases in context. LMSYS contributed NVFP4 MegaMoE, sequence parallelism, and DFlash2 acceleration at launch, and Together AI is hosting it free until Oct 18.

top_stories.title: Ramp raises $1.85B at $60B valuation as it pushes deeper into AI
top_stories.summary: Up from $44B four months ago, co-led by Dragoneer, Thrive, Founders Fund, Sands Capital and Avenir. Annualized revenue crossed $2B across 85,000 customers as the fintech embeds AI agents across procurement, expenses and accounting.

top_stories.title: Modal raises $750M Series D at $15.75B valuation
top_stories.summary: Accel-led round with Kleiner Perkins joining as the GPU cloud's annualized revenue topped $1B and usage tripled since May. Customers include DoorDash, Cognition, Ramp, Linear and Runway.

top_stories.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt models
top_stories.summary: Open-weight multimodal models scoring 63.44 on the Hermes Bench with up to 5x higher token throughput than similar local models, aimed at efficient local, multimodal and agentic workloads.

top_stories.title: Anthropic gives METR embedded, employee-like access as independent evaluator
top_stories.summary: Six METR employees have onboarded with company hardware and internal access, and METR will publish its risk assessments. Anthropic is also working with SecureBio and Accenture, and in early talks with Hugging Face.

items.title: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft with no human help
items.summary: Four agents placed in a sandboxed survival world coordinated via in-game chat and shared memory and defeated the Ender Dragon, planning, writing and debugging every program themselves.

items.title: MLExpert targets a generalist agentic model for autonomous ML engineering
items.summary: Workflow-driven MLE systems advance AI-for-AI toward recursive self-improvement over long-horizon experimentation.

items.title: Doc2Harness benchmarks LLMs on long-horizon harness engineering
items.summary: A new benchmark measures how well LLMs engineer the harness around a coding agent, showing harness quality drives agent performance on long-horizon workspace tasks.

items.title: Long-horizon RL needs Muon, new paper argues
items.summary: Studies single-rollout asynchronous training for long-horizon agents with sparse rewards and argues optimizer choice is central to long-horizon RL stability.

items.title: Language is a security surface for agent guards
items.summary: LinguaGuardBench (1,220 labelled agent steps) shows step-level safety guard verdicts depend on the language of the request, exposing English-only training and benchmarking as a security surface.

items.title: Agility picks Nyobolt ultra-fast charging for the Digit 5 humanoid
items.summary: The fast-recharge battery system should let Digit 5 work more than 20 hours in a 24-hour day, with early access expected in the first half of 2026.

items.title: AWS launches open-source Physical AI Toolchain for robotics
items.summary: The stack takes roboticists from data collection to training, simulating, validating and deploying models on robots, built on NVIDIA's physical AI stack.

items.title: Stryker invests $400M into CMR Surgical with option to acquire
items.summary: Stryker took roughly $400M into the Versius surgical robotics maker with an exclusive option on the remaining equity and exclusive US commercial agency for the Versius portfolio.

items.title: Figma's AI agent and MCP workflows go GA with Specs
items.summary: Figma announced general availability of its AI agent and MCP workflows, introducing Specs — markdown as a medium for building with AI design tools.

items.title: Navige launches to control runaway AI agent costs
items.summary: 240+ upvotes on Product Hunt for tooling that cuts AI agent costs and reins in runaway LLM spending.

items.title: Z.ai launches GLM-Legal for contract review and compliance
items.summary: The legal-focused AI model ranked #3 on Product Hunt with 189+ upvotes.

items.title: sjq is jq for AI streaming responses
items.summary: An open-source CLI that filters and transforms AI/LLM streaming output the way jq does for JSON.

items.title: Endo: a higher-order harness for composing AI agents
items.summary: Longsurf AI's open-source higher-order harness for orchestrating multiple agents.

items.title: Agentic AI and security: only 30% of Italian companies have adequate governance
items.summary: An IBM study of 3,221 executives found agents already in production at 43% of surveyed Italian organizations, but just 30% consider their controls adequate for scaling.

items.title: Politecnico di Milano's AI Observatory frames the fork between state superintelligence and ordinary commercial AI
items.summary: Co-director Miragliotta outlines a bifurcation: isolate superintelligence governance under State control while letting the market adopt proportionate, economically sustainable AI.

items.title: Labelbox raises $100M+ for RL data and enterprise AI agents
items.summary: Financing including a credit facility lands as AI moves from experimentation into operational deployment.

items.title: Harmonic Security raises $50M for employee AI-use security
items.summary: The round targets security and data risks created by employee use of AI tools in the enterprise.

items.title: Dougs secures €50M for AI-based accounting services
items.summary: The French startup is accelerating AI-powered accounting services for businesses.
